concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-components-overview-after-payment-transactions-component]] — Transactions Overview/Details data, role-gated refunds, session setup, and CSV limits (2026-09-15).
warnings: CSV is limited to first 100 matching rows, not complete reconciliation.
Refund action submits an API request and displays status; final refund outcome or shopper receipt requires separate evidence.
Credential and session roles both gate refund, and features vary by library version.
